body:
Hyperspace jesters are darkly hysterical in my universe - entirely hypnotic and hyper-intelligent with a sharp sense of humor I can't put into words.
An alien humor I can't describe - I still can't put it into words - it was horrifyingly perfect and I wasnt afraid of being remotely controlled like a puppet by this higher intelligence after a few seconds of adjusting to the outrageously hypnotic, organically-robotic movements, but it was ridiculously fun and insanely hyper-intelligent and HILARIOUS in a way I cant even begin to explain - I was almost terrified - gorgeously, chemically, emotionally, mentally and physically in love and I knew everything and it was perfection - nonstop laughter created by organized insanity.
Hilarious because it was horrifyingly, hysterically, psychotically, perfectly intelligent with an indescribably OH SHIT I REMEMBER THIS - I'M THIS IN THE AFTERLIFE sensation.
A cosmic tango.
Love
I cant explain why, but Im hypnotically, obsessively drawn to these jesters, yet I always have a hard time writing about hyperspace jesters because I feel like they sabotage me.
Its like they dont want me to explain them correctly.
which might be the punchline.
